trigger.min_hits_hint: Number of presses within 5s to fire
trigger.scope_hint: Fires once per press, regardless of how many scoped receivers observe the signal.
assign.heading: Assign Signal
assign.send_times_hint: Transmit this command this many times per press, for devices that need a repeat. Default 1.
assign.ditto_title: Append repeat frames after the main frame; some strict receivers need at least one to register the command.

assign.no_devices: No devices yet. Switch to "New Device" to create one.
assign.failed_duplicate: Assignment failed. The signal may have a duplicate code on the target device.
pluckdlg.blaster_required: Pick a blaster to pluck from.
pluckdlg.no_response: No response from blaster. Try again.
pluckdlg.command_help: The name you gave this code when you learned it in the vendor app.
pluckdlg.no_blasters: No compatible blasters found. Install a supported IR integration (such as Tuya Local) and learn a code first.
editor.ditto_disabled_cmd: Ditto count applies when the command transmits as NEC. Toggle the pill to NEC to enable.
editor.ditto_disabled: Ditto count applies to signals that decode as NEC. Raw Pronto codes transmit as captured.
editor.ditto_disabled_protocol: Dittos are an NEC repeat frame. {protocol} has no equivalent, so the count would never reach the wire.
editor.snap_notice: Carrier is {khz} kHz, off the IR standards. Some receivers reject it.
editor.trigger_note_cmd: This command has a trigger that will automatically re-point.
editor.trigger_note_sig: This signal has a trigger that will automatically re-point.
editor.send_times_title: Transmit the whole command this many times as independent presses, for devices that need a repeat to register.
editor.ditto_title: Append repeat frames after the main frame. Some strict receivers, notably commercial audio gear, need at least one to register the command.
editor.replace_hint: Point the remote at a receiver and press Listen, or paste a code above.
editor.listen_hint: Press the button on the remote now.
editor.listen_missed: Nothing heard. Try again, closer to a receiver.
editor.heard_rough: Heard, but it did not decode. Usable as captured bytes.
mirror.unknown_hint: {name} fired, but nothing was close enough to hear what it said. Place a receiver in earshot to catch the next send.
mirror.assign_disabled: Identity unknown -- nothing was heard back to assign
mirror.assign_title: Assign this signal to a HAIR device
mirror.test_title: Send this signal through an emitter to test it
mirror.trigger_create: Fires when this signal arrives from outside Home Assistant
mirror.delete_title: Clear this entry (it returns on the next send)
mirror.empty_sub: Commands sent by HAIR devices, automations, or any integration on the infrared platform will appear here, with where they went and who heard them.
mirror.del_trigger_msg: Remove this trigger permanently? Automations using it will stop firing.
mirror.clear_msg: Remove this entry from the Mirror? It will come back the next time this signal is sent.

devlist.rx_bridge_active: Legacy bridge still active. Native receiver supersedes it -- you can remove the on_pronto: block from your ESPHome config.

devlist.rx_upgrade_title: Upgrade to HA 2026.6+ for native receiver support
devlist.tx_native_title: Sends via HA's native infrared platform
devlist.del_trigger_msg: Remove "{name}"? The associated HA event entity will also be removed.
devlist.del_device_msg: Remove "{name}"? Commands, action mappings, and emitter assignments will be deleted. Triggers are unaffected.
devdetail.no_commands: No commands yet. Add one below.

devdetail.clip_title: Paste a new signal in Clips
devdetail.mirror_title: Overhear a send in the Mirror

devdetail.del_trigger_msg: Remove this trigger? The associated HA event entity will also be removed.
sniffer.title: HAIR Sniffer
sniffer.empty_body: When unrecognized IR signals are received by your ESPHome devices, they will appear here automatically.
sniffer.empty_hint: Try pressing a button on a remote that hasn't been configured yet.
sniffer.norx_title: No IR receiver is set up
sniffer.norx_body: HAIR has no way to receive IR signals yet, so the Sniffer cannot capture anything.
sniffer.norx_hint: Set up an ESPHome receiver with the infrared platform, or check Settings, then Devices and Services, to confirm your IR device is adopted.
sniffer.clear_all_title: Wipe the entire unknown catalog AND the dismiss list. Use Show Dismissed before Clear All if you want to retain individual dismissed entries.
sniffer.del_signal_msg: Remove this signal permanently? This cannot be undone.
sniffer.clear_all_confirm_msg: Remove all unknown signals and devices? This cannot be undone.
sniffer.trigger_create: Create an HA event entity that fires on this signal
clips.title: HAIR Clipper
clips.empty_body: Clipper lets you build remotes by pasting Pronto codes. Create a remote, then add a signal for each button.
clips.empty_hint: Click "+ Add" above to start a clipped remote.
clips.clear_all_title: Delete all clipped remotes and their signals. Sniffed signals are untouched.
clips.add_signal_title: Add a signal to this remote
clips.no_signals: No signals yet. Click "+ Add Signal" to paste a Pronto code.
clips.delete_remote_title: Delete this remote and all its signals
clips.test_title: Send this signal through an emitter
clips.clear_all_confirm_msg: Remove all clipped remotes and their signals? This cannot be undone. Sniffed signals are not affected.
clips.del_remote_msg_n.one: Remove "{name}" and its {count} signal? This cannot be undone.
clips.del_remote_msg_n.other: Remove "{name}" and its {count} signals? This cannot be undone.
clips.signpost_body: This remote was clipped from the wig {filename}. Adopting it flat copies its {count} signals as plain commands, with no thermostat.
clips.signpost_wig_road: Adopting the wig instead creates a real thermostat driven by the full state matrix.
clips.signpost_gone: The wig this remote was clipped from, {filename}, is no longer in the closet.
clips.signpost_gone_hint: Re-import the original wig file to adopt it as a thermostat.
pluck.vendor_unavailable: This blaster's integration is not available right now. Make sure the vendor integration is loaded.
pluck.title: HAIR Plucker
pluck.empty_body: The Plucker imports IR codes from your existing blasters so you can use them in HAIR without re-learning each one.
pluck.empty_hint: Click "+ Add Blaster" above to mirror a blaster.
pluck.clear_all_title: Delete all plucked blasters and their signals. Sniffed and clipped signals are untouched.
pluck.promote_title: Create a HAIR device from this blaster
pluck.pluck_signal_title: Pluck a code off this blaster
pluck.no_signals: No signals yet. Click "+ Pluck Signal" to pull a code off this blaster.
pluck.delete_blaster_title: Delete this blaster and all its signals
pluck.clear_all_confirm_msg: Remove all plucked blasters and their signals? This cannot be undone. Sniffed and clipped signals are not affected.
panel.tagline.wigs: Your closet of portable code sets. Try one on, share your own.
wigs.drop.title: Drop a {wig}, {smartir}, {flipper}, {lirc}, or {girr} file anywhere on this tab
wigs.drop.hint: Files land in /config/hair/wigs/ and appear below
wigs.title: HAIR Closet
wigs.clip_matrix_confirm: This will create up to {count} signals on the Clipper. Are you sure?
wigs.clip_matrix_slow: Large sets can be slow to browse.
wigs.try_on_failed: Could not try on this wig: {message}
wigs.empty: The closet is empty. Save a remote as a wig, or drop a .wig.json file here.
wigs.invalid_file: {filename} could not be read: {reason} Fix the file and it will appear here.
wigs.origin.captured: Exported from signals captured on real hardware.
wigs.origin.clipped: Assembled in the Clipper from pasted or library codes.
wigs.origin.plucked: Plucked from a live integration's code store.
wigs.origin.device: Exported from a HAIR device's commands.
wigs.origin.converted: Converted from {format}. Not yet tested on hardware.
wigs.origin.library: Rendered from the built-in code library.
wigs.delete_confirm: Delete {filename}? The file is removed from your closet. Remotes you already tried on stay.
wigs.upload_failed: That file is not a valid wig: {reason}
wigs.saved_skipped: Saved as {filename} ({skipped} signals had no code and were left out)
wigs.save.lattice_changed.one: You changed one state on this device that {name} also has.
wigs.save.lattice_changed.other: You changed {count} states on this device that {name} also has.
wigs.save.propose_lattice: Propose these changes to the wig
wigs.save.lattice_blocks_attestation: A fitting vouches for the whole set of states, so it cannot be signed while yours differ. Propose the changes above, or save without attesting.
wigs.save.cells_proposed.one: One state proposed to the wig.
wigs.save.explainer: A perfect fit is your signed claim that every code here works on your own device. It travels with the wig, so the next person knows somebody proved it on real hardware.
wigs.save.nothing_to_attest: There is nothing to attest yet: this device has no codes and no state matrix. Add some, then come back.
wigs.save.source_missing: This device came from a wig that is no longer in the closet, so this will save a new one.
wigs.save.downgrade: {checked} of {total} checked. This saves as a scoped fitting rather than a perfect fit.
wigs.save.reason_hint: Leave both unpicked to make no claim about this row.
wigs.save.rename_line: The wig calls this {theirs}; you call it {yours}.
wigs.save.oath: I attest every checked signal works on my device as written.
wigs.save.rename_wig_warning: This renames {name} itself. It does not create a second wig, and the file keeps the name it was first saved under.
supersede.title: Replace your current Wig?
supersede.body: This new Wig has {new} signals where your current Wig, {name}, has {old}.
supersede.carried_all: All {count} of your signals carry forward.
supersede.refit_note: Your fitting of the current Wig retires with it; test the new buttons and attest again to put your name on this one.
supersede.lost.one: Your current Wig has 1 signal the new one doesn't carry: {names}.
supersede.lost.other: Your current Wig has {count} signals the new one doesn't carry: {names}.
supersede.device_follows.one: {name} came from your current Wig and follows the new one.
supersede.device_follows.other: {count} devices came from your current Wig and follow the new one.
supersede.fitted_scoped.one: {name} carries a fitting by {who}; replacing it retires it.
supersede.fitted_scoped.other: {name} carries {count} fittings by {who}; replacing it retires them.
supersede.fitted_perfect: {name} carries a PERFECT FIT by {who}. Replacing it retires that proof; the new wig is unproven until somebody fits it.
supersede.reverse_message: A newer wig here supersedes this one: {name}, {count} signals. Import anyway?
wigs.save.stale_renames: These renames did not land, because the wig no longer has those rows: {names}
wigs.save.no_emitter: This device has no emitter, so there is nothing to send through.
wigs.export.heading: Save to Closet
sniffer.del_remote_msg: Delete "{name}" and its signals? The remote returns if it is heard again.
sniffer.delete_remote_title: Delete this remote and all its signals
wigs.upload_partial: {count} signals could not convert (see the wig notes)
wigs.upload_dropped_fittings.one: 1 fitting in the old whole-file form was set aside; it cannot become per-row claims. Re-fit to restore the proof.
wigs.upload_dropped_fittings.other: {count} fittings in the old whole-file form were set aside; they cannot become per-row claims. Re-fit to restore the proof.
wigs.upload_one_at_a_time: {count} files at once. The closet takes one at a time, so nothing was hung -- drop a single file.
wigs.receipt.duplicate: {name} hung under {brand} -- an identical device was already in {brands}
wigs.editor.ids_hint: Product identifiers, all optional. Separate multiples with commas.
wigs.editor.kind_hint: What the device is. Helps others find it when wigs are shared in the Wig Shop.
comb.heading: {name} — Combing
comb.clean: Nothing to report. The codes are consistent with each other.
comb.footer: Combing checks that the codes agree with each other. Only a fitting proves them on the device.
comb.truncated: {count} more were found but not stored.
comb.tip_clean: Combed {date}: nothing to report. Click to comb again.
comb.what.duplicated-neighbour: responds, but with the wrong state
comb.what.frame-shape: does not match the rest of this remote
comb.what.stray-burst: harmless; the capture was not clean
comb.duplicated_neighbour: Sends the same code as {other}, in a row that otherwise changes at every step.
comb.frame_short: Frame {frame} is {timings} timings short of every other code here.
comb.frame_missing: Short by {missing} of the repeated frames.
comb.frame_shape: {pairs} burst pairs where the rest of the lattice sends {expected}.
comb.frame_outlier: {pairs} burst pairs against a median of {median} for this remote.
comb.frame_count: {frames} frames where the rest of this remote sends {expected}.
comb.stray_burst: One extra timing after the last frame.
comb.tip_suspects.one: {count} suspect code. Click for the report.
comb.tip_suspects.other: {count} suspect codes. Click for the report.
comb.bypass_with_dittos: Pinned to raw and carrying {count} dittos. A raw code keeps its repeats in the bytes, so the dittos will not be sent.
comb.ramp_dittos: {count} dittos on a button that steps a value. Some receivers step once per ditto, so this may be deliberate.
chip.bypass_tip: Bypassing the detected protocol, sending raw Pronto
chip.bypass_action: Click to transmit clean decoded timings instead.
chip.decoded_action: Click to send the captured code as-is.
wigs.fit_tick.scoped: Fitted by {fitters}, with exclusions. {covered} of {total} states proven between them.
devdetail.del_cell_msg: {name} leaves this device's state matrix. The climate control stops offering it. Other states are untouched.
claims.heading: Fittings on {name}
claims.none: Nobody has attested this wig yet.
claims.bad_sig_what: The claims still stand; what is in doubt is who made them.
claims.lattice_moved: The state matrix has changed since this fitting, so it no longer describes the states on this wig.
claims.footer: A fitting is one person's signed claim about the rows they tested. Adopt this wig to make your own.
wigs.save.joining_proven.one: One person has proven this wig. You would be the next.
wigs.save.joining_proven.other: {count} people have proven this wig. You would be the next.
wigs.save.joining_see.one: See the fitting it already carries
wigs.save.joining_see.other: See the {count} fittings it already carries
comb.explain_lead: Combing runs every code past its neighbors and {lint}
comb.bucket_wrong_body: The device answers the press and lands in a state you did not ask for. Worth repairing before you fit the wig.
comb.bucket_ignored_body: The press does not land. Nothing wrong happens; nothing happens at all.
comb.bucket_cosmetic_body: Artefacts of how the codes were captured. They transmit correctly.
comb.summary_truncated: Found, but not stored with the receipt.
comb.handoff_adopt: Adopt this wig to fix them.
comb.handoff_adopt_body: Every flagged code becomes a row on the device, marked with a comb glyph, ready to test and replace.
comb.handoff_open_body: Look for the comb glyph. Press them, replace what fails, then save back to the closet.
comb.handoff_open.one: The flagged code is a row on {device}.
